parts.name: Lab Coat Male
parts.desc: a scientist's long white laboratory coat with long sleeves, a notched lapel collar, buttoned front, a breast pocket with pens and a clip-on ID badge, worn over a light blue shirt and dark tie The torso piece must keep the input's exact outline: same neckline height, same shoulder width and same hem, nothing sticking out above the neckline, so the body is fully covered with no gaps at the shoulders. The coat is white, drawn with light grey shading and a clear black outline all round so it stands out from the white background.

parts.name: Lab Coat Female
parts.desc: a scientist's white laboratory coat with long sleeves, a notched lapel collar, buttoned front, a breast pocket with pens and a clip-on ID badge, worn over a lavender blouse The coat is white, drawn with light grey shading and a clear black outline all round so it stands out from the white background.

parts.name: Lab Coat Tails
parts.desc: the lower part of an open white laboratory coat: two white coat panels hanging from the waist to just above the knee with side pockets, open down the middle so the trousers show between them The coat is white, drawn with light grey shading and a clear black outline all round so it stands out from the white background.

parts.name: Grey Slacks Male
parts.desc: plain charcoal-grey wool trousers with a black leather belt and creased legs

parts.name: Grey Slacks Female
parts.desc: plain charcoal-grey tailored trousers with a thin black belt

parts.name: Safety Goggles
parts.desc: clear plastic laboratory safety goggles with a grey elastic strap, pushed up and resting on top of the head above the forehead (goggles only, no head, no hair)

parts.name: Black Oxford Shoes
parts.desc: plain black leather oxford shoes with laces. The sheet has three shoes: the top two are side views (toe pointing right); the bottom one is the same shoe seen from the FRONT, toe pointing straight at the viewer.
